title: The Dynamic Duo
bio: The pair with twin-sibling-like chemistry. Fumio and Alicia find endless possibilities to make each other laugh, cringe, and wrestle to the ground, 24/7/365.

title: Attracted Opposites
bio: Growing up with each other, Vyse couldn't be helped but be influenced by Fumio's energy. They cover each other's flaws, so it's rare to see them not rely on each other for once.

title: Alpha Bros
bio: Whenever Riku needs a lab rat, or someone who can teach him how to do board tricks, its always Fumio who's willing to step up in exchange for some chicken nuggets, so both parties are happy in the end.

title: Playdate from Switzerland
bio: At a young age, Fumio and Emma were very acquainted and got along real fast. During that time, Emma has been getting intel from him for her little puppy crush, and Fumio's enjoying every single second of it.

title: The Persistent Menace
bio: Like a big sister schooling her little brother, Its always up to Karin to scold Fumio for doing something brash. At one point, she claims to pay for his psychiatric bills and fix his brain from "failing".

title: Resonated Wonder
bio: The last thing Fumiko expected was to fall for "the weird kid". Thank goodness she rivals his mother's patience for dealing with his madness. And, yes, them having similar names is a considered factor for them hitting it off.

title: Duo Sentai-Red!
bio: Two anime geeks walk into a bar... and everyone else leaves. 'Cuz once these two get their conversation going, the Sun would collapse before they'd run out of fandoms.

title: The Imposter Among Us
bio: Fumio is smart enough to not cause trouble around Shioriko... He witnessed first-hand on what punishment she did to Alicia, so thank the gods that she isn't aware of what chaos he does day-to-day.

title: Guided Gratitude
bio: Despite a turbulent history that involved extreme violence between them, Fumio served as a key mentor figure for Rikki and offered him the guidance and opportunities needed to integrate with the group, holding no lingering resentment for stabbing a claymore through his back.

title: Perpetual Nuisance
bio: Despite George being the expected dominant figure, Fumio constantly gets under his skin, driving him to endless exasperation. George knew it was a bad idea to associate himself with a Hasashi, but for a completely different reason than this...

title: Uneasy Truce
bio: Fumio never lets his guard down around Makoto, harboring a persistent distrust he can't fully hide. Makoto easily sees through the uncharacteristic silent act of his and never lets him hear the end of it, in which case Fumio to simply yield and nod in agreement.

title: The Geekification
bio: Fumio introduced to Megumi the concept of overanalyzing their childhood movies. Megumi would never be the same again after sitting through countless credits of movies in hopes of a post-credit scene.

title: Another Me
bio: Its not just the pretty face and foul mouth Fumio inherited from his mother. It is believed that he acquired Meari's past split personality. Every now and then, she'd anticipate and act like her old chuunibyou self next to her son. Unfortunately for her, Fumio is absolutely clueless with her antics...

title: A Dream Come True
bio: He did it... Hanzo proved his father wrong. Regardless of Fumio potentially disappointing his ancestors, he was Hanzo's to love and care for.

title: A Different Side
bio: It was always weird to Fumio how contrasting his dad's soft and calm demeneaur compared to Uncle Sato's loud and energetic one. He welcomes it though, its like he has two dads around for comfort.

title: Bad Memories
bio: Fumio always loved how hospitable Auntie Michan is, but he can't help but remember the time as a kid, he'll always get choked by bosoms when Michan decides to hug him. It's way too awkward for him to bring it up in family gatherings...

title: The Appointed Uncle
bio: Meari HATED the idea that her son is the nephew of the one she loathes, but it was ultinately Hanzo's decision. Unfortunately for Matsuda, he hates it as much... Being forced to protect the living manifestation of all of his pet peeves.

title: That one Babysitter
bio: Fumio would always recall his interactions with Uncle Kaito. Introducing him to such delightful food, but he worries about his french toast intake... He might explode one day.

title: The Missing Link
bio: Fumio thought Auntie Minna was pretty cool, being so kind and sweet, until she mysteriously stopped showing up. All that talk about being his mum's best friend... He wonders what happened to her.

title: Unlike Father Unlike Son
bio: Remembering Leonardo showing up in his childhood, Fumio can connect the dots with him and Makoto... He wasn't as cunning and dangerous as Makoto, but he can't help but be under the impression that they are hiding something... That's one thing in common.

title: "Barbie Doll" for a Mom
bio:
Fumio always wondered whose genetics could make Karin. Looking at her mum... Yeah, its exactly what he envisioned. Great hair, curvy body, the "dominant mommy" vibes?
 
"That'll do...", Fumio says, "That'll do."

title: Father's Old Admirer
bio: Finding out his Auntie Meili once had the hots for his dad, Fumio's respect for her grew exponentially. Even receiving attention from her, claiming that Meari and Hanzo's genetics mixed like jelly and peanut butter. Maybe as the symbol of women empowerment, she just likes how much of a girl he looks...

title: Luckiest Man in the World
bio: Fumio met Akira through Auntie Meili, finding out that they hid their relationship from the public, and got busy as well. All Fumio could ever think was... "Nice".

title: A Nice Change of Pace
bio: What Matsuda lacks in tolerating Fumio, Aika compensates. She enjoys the harmless pranks Matsuda had to suffer from him when he was just a wee-baby. It's the tough love he needs to learn, and she's thankful Fumio can teach him the hard way.

title: Vyse's Go-To
bio: Mira bestowed Fumio the protection Vyse needs that caters to his introverted nature, so long as she promises him some fish crackers.

title: Hope for Young Blood
bio: Leng's view of his comrade's son is nothing but pure astonishment. Being able to live a peaceful life he wants while also making the old Authors proud demands his respect more than anyone would ever dare to imagine.

title: Childhood Crush
bio: Growing up, Alicia always had a soft spot for the cute kid her cousin deemed his best friend, until she eventually noticed his obvious disinterest. Maybe there's someone out there who thinks of her the same way...

title: The Nerd and The Jock
bio: Riku always had been secretly attracted to Alicia since their younger days. As she got older, "Who would have thought Riku-kun would grow up into such a hottie," Alicia thought to herself.

title: The Adopted Lamb
bio: Once Uncle Matsuda adopted the young Emma Verde, she was Alicia's first exposure to how girls her age act. Too bad she has to share her with everyone else in the gang, she thinks...

title: Diver Diva
bio: Two fashion enthusiasts refuse to half-bake their efforts at pairing their clothes when they're side-by-side. Sometimes it does go out of hand, and they'll eventually compete as rivals to push each other to an even grander style.

title: The Start of Something New
bio: They met when the Student Council collaborated with the Student Athletes for a festival. To Fumiko, it was the moment that her entire world had a new breath of fresh air. Without Alicia, she couldn't have met such amazing people.

title: Ali-Setsu Scarlet Storm!
bio: If you feel a Magnitude 5 Earthquake coming from the School Idol Club, don't fret. That's just two artists in the making, drowning in their field of ideas for the next festival. Someone get some Solar Panels and harvest that energy...

title: The Problem Child
bio: Alicia never ceases to surprise Shioriko on finding new ways to upset her... Though went Shioriko found out that Alicia grew up around boys, things went easier between them.

title: A Different Fumio
bio: The more Alicia hangs out with Rikki, the more she realizes that Rikki's just a handicapped Fumio, which doesn't give her a reason to love him any less. Rikki's just happy to have a sister-figure, no matter how loud and wreckless.

title: This is Getting Out of Hand...
bio:
George can't even handle a fraction of Fumio's madness... He can barely imagine handling both Hasashis at the same time.

That...sounded weird, but George would never word that better himself.

title: The Corrupt Secretary
bio: Makoto gives Alicia the creeps... She often wonders how he won the election of being a Student Council Member. Is he actually good at what he's doing? Did he bribe people with money? 'Cuz she'd admit, if she got paid enough, she'd start a campaign for him.

title: Color Her World
bio: Alicia is an anxious person's dream. A big gateway for connections, and she respects her space, just the way she likes it. That's why she is Megumi's go-to for a good girls' night.

title: Fum-Fum's Mommy
bio: Alicia always saw Auntie Meari like she was a celebrity. Always owning the room whenever she went with her cool and collected demeneaur. That's why she wasn't surprised when she owned her own restauraunt, no man can ever resist such a beauty...

title: It's Always in the Eyes
bio: Back when they sported the same haircut, almost no one could tell the twins apart. That's why everytime they're in the same room, Alicia makes sure to spot which one is quieter, and which one...makes friends a lot.

title: Heritage from the Stars
bio: Alicia sees her daddy as her one true idol no athlete can compete. As she got older, she realized how much her dad holds back on her on the court. Only after she became competent was when he was giving it his all to his cheesecake.

title: The Apple and The Tree
bio: It makes sense how much energy Alicia has, seeing how hyper of a couple her parents are. She does wish she would at least inherit her mum's figure... Maybe once she reaches adolescence.

title: Mini Michan
bio: Babysitting Alicia is as bad as Fumio, Matsuda says... Although he can't help and see a younger, happier version of his dear sister. That's something to make the pain of dealing with these kids tolerable...

title: Mum's Co-Worker
bio:
Alicia sees Uncle Kaito as that single guy who's always busy, thats why whenever he does show up, she expects gifts. Like, a lot. If you work a lot, then you must have a lot of money... 

Oh, if only Alicia knew the real world.

title: The Rich Auntie
bio: Riku's big sister and one of Mum's Best Friends... She must be pretty loaded, Alicia thinks. Hoping she'd get some souvernirs, but instead her Auntie ends up being a no show... So much for that.

title: NOT REGISTERED YET
bio: NOT REGISTERED YET

title: Solitary Alliance
bio: Both prefer blending into the background whenever possible. A bind made clear by their childhood ties to the Hasashi cousins. Riku respects Vyse's quiet demeanor, while Vyse finds comfort in Riku's grounded nature amidst the constant chaos of their friend group.

title: Match Made in Heaven
bio: The perfect swiss girl deserves their perfect comfort boy. Their voices harmonize with each other, they share a long history, and are the greenest of green flags. What madman would ruin such innocent young love?

title: The Unspoken Catalyst
bio: As Emma's closest friend, Karin was the one who pushed her to finally make things official with Vyse. Though she secretly admitted to falling for Vyse's quiet charm herself, she chose to champion her best friend's happiness instead, keeping her own feelings to herself, projecting it through harmless teasing.

title: The Former Flame
bio: Vyse was actually Fumiko's very first crush, even prompting her to write him a song in an attempt to win him over. Though it ended in a painful rejection, Fumiko handled the situation with grace, ensuring they made peace so they could remain in the same circle without any lingering tension or awkwardness.

title: The Uncrowned Prince
bio:
Setsuna constantly gushes over Vyse's visuals, insisting he looks like he walked straight out of one of her favorite light novels and pushing him to try cosplaying.
 
Vyse politely took the compliment and secretly entertained the thought for a while, though his quiet nature kept him from ever actually stepping onto the stage.

title: Cleared Misconceptions
bio: Shioriko initially confronted Vyse, assuming he had intentionally hurt Fumiko during her rejection. Once the misunderstanding was cleared up, Shioriko gained immense respect for Vyse's gentle honesty and mature handling of the situation, even admitting she wishes more people conducted themselves with his level of integrity.

title: The Walking Experiment
bio: Vyse feels an overwhelming sense of pity for Rikki, unsettled by the unnatural experimentation done to Rikki's anatomy. He can barely fathom the horror of having one's body modified against their will, driving him to treat Rikki with extra care and quiet empathy.

title: A Nice Change of Pace
bio: In a circle dominated by relentless chaos, George finds Vyse to be a rare breath of fresh air. H genuinely respects him because out of everyone who teases him, Vyse's subtle humor is the only kind that is actually funny and completely tolerable.

title: Bitter Obsession
bio:
Vyse's relationship with Emma makes him the sole target of Makoto's intense, one-sided hatred, as Makoto views Emma as something that should belong to him. 

Driven by envy, Makoto tried relentlessly to dig into Vyse's past to find something to break him, only to be infuriated when Vyse's quiet composure refused to crack.

title: A Quiet Endorsement
bio: Megumi feels a profound sense of comfort around him. Seeing his gentle and grounding nature firsthand, she openly supports his relationship with Emma, firmly believing that Vyse is exactly what Emma needs in her life.

title: Striking Splendor
bio: Meari rarely hands out compliments on physical appearances, but even she couldn't hide her genuine impression at how strikingly mature Vyse grew up to be. Knowing his family line, she considers his refined composure completely expected. After all, he was raised by equally beautiful parents.

title: Echoes of Quiet Passion
bio: During his visits to Fumio's house, Vyse picked up on how quiet Uncle Hanzo naturally is. But whenever Hanzo does speak, his words are so full of warmth and genuine kindness that Vyse feels a deep kinship with him, if not outright awe. Seeing his grounded demeanor only leaves Vyse completely baffled as to how Fumio turned out so wildly different from his own father.

title: Unshakeable Integrity
bio: Satoshi holds immense respect for Vyse, constantly commending him for staying grounded, honoring his family, and resisting everyday temptations, a level of maturity he rarely sees in kids his age. He frequently teases Vyse that whoever manages to win his heart in the end is bound to be the luckiest girl in the world.

title: What Could Have Been?
bio: At some point, Michan harborbed a wish for Alicia to end up with Vyse, knowing her daughter would be completely safe in his hands.

title: An Incomplete Verdict
bio:
Matsuda couldn't stand watching his adopted daughter and Vyse's painfully obvious romantic tension. 

While he initially disapproved and kept a sharp eye on him, watching Vyse's consistent integrity and genuine care proved he was the real deal, forcing Matsuda to begrudgingly admit that maybe Aika was right about the boy all along.

title: The Unspoken Heritage
bio: Kaito could recognize Vyse as Leng's son from a mile away, seeing his father's unmistakable resemblance every time they train together. Despite Leng being the sole Author who adamantly opposed passing down their arts to his offspring, Kaito actively helps keep the secret, honoring the silent pact to train Vyse in the arts behind his father's back.

title: Unintentional Slip-Up
bio: Rikka was actually the one who accidentally let slip that Karin had a crush on Vyse. Upon realizing what she said, Vyse quietly promised to keep the secret to himself, fully aware of how badly Karin would freak out if she ever found out. A reaction that brought a rare, amused smile to Rikka's face.

title: Between You and Me
bio: As one of Leng's closest and most trusted comrades, Meili stepped up to become a vital mentor for Vyse. Knowing how strictly Leng opposed passing down their combat heritage, she actively helped train Vyse in his father's techniques behind his back, ensuring his legacy lives on through his son's growth.

title: Kids Nowadays...
bio:
Akira was genuinely baffled when Vyse of all people joined in on poking fun at him for landing and "getting freaky" with Auntie Meili. 

Shocked to see his pure image shatter, Akira called him out for not being the innocent kid he thought he was. Vyse just gave him a teasing smirk and casually asked him to keep it a secret, proving he’s got a mischievous side hidden under that quiet exterior.

title: The Mastermind's Push
bio:
Aika is fully and unapologetically supportive of Emma and Vyse's relationship, actively taking matters into her own hands to make sure they spend as much time together as possible. 

She is the driving force behind their rapid progress, constantly pulling strings behind the scenes to assign Vyse as Emma's official partner for every event they're in.

title: Admiration of Ages
bio:
Mira takes immense pride in her son, often wishing a boy with his looks and talent would become a full-fledged celebrity. However, she understands him far too well to push it, knowing the spotlight completely contradicts his quiet nature. 

Even so, simply hearing rumors of how surprisingly popular Vyse is back at Nijigasaki is more than enough to put a proud smile on her face.

title: Pride in Your Legacy
bio:
Vyse holds his prideful and stoic father in the highest regard, constantly hoping to bridge the quiet gap between them and connect on a deeper level. 

Fortunately, pleasing Leng requires far less than Vyse thinks; beneath his strict exterior, Leng only wants the best for his son. Rather than forcing him into his own shadow, Leng’s true desire is simply to see Vyse forge a path genuinely built on his own passions.

title: Sparks of Curiosity
bio: To Emma, Riku is easily the smartest person she knows, and she loves spending time learning the intricate mechanics behind how he builds his gadgets. Even though his high-level explanations frequently leave her feeling completely dazed and ditzy, her confusion always gives way to genuine awe, leaving her endlessly astonished by just how brilliant he is.

title: Unfathomable Genius
bio: Karin is constantly left bewildered by the sheer inner workings of Riku's brain, often wondering if his terrifying intellect stems from his lineage of a Youmu and a literal robot. Baffling mind aside, she is immensely grateful to have such a brilliant mind in her corner, relying on him as a dependable lifeline whenever schoolwork gets overwhelming.

title: Exceptional Minds
bio: Riku teasingly considers Fumio one of the luckiest guys alive for ending up with his childhood crush—especially one who aged like fine wine. For her part, Fumiko holds Riku’s intellect in high regard, recognizing him as one of the exceedingly rare students at Nijigasaki capable of effortlessly breezing through Advanced Assessments.

title: Stage Safeguard
bio: Setsuna has always been eager to ride Riku's custom Aeroboard during a live performance, but Riku firmly and respectfully declines every time, prioritizing her safety above all else and preferring she express her passion through her own boundless energy. Undeterred, Setsuna is more than delighted to have him handle the stage's pyrotechnics instead to unleash the ultimate explosive performance.

title: The Boundary Line
bio: Riku is one of the few people bold enough to snitch on Alicia directly to Shioriko, frequently serving as the catalyst for Alicia getting chewed out by the Student Council Member. While both of them genuinely wish Alicia would act a bit more orderly, they secretly hold a mutual agreement: completely stripping away her wild, chaotic charm would undo what makes her who she is.

title: Biological Marvels
bio:
While studying Rikki's unique anatomy, Riku is left constantly unsettled by just how cruel and inhumane the Satsujin Clan's body modifications truly are.

Yet, from a purely scientific standpoint, he can't help but be genuinely impressed. The fact that Rikki can seamlessly store his massive signature tentacles internally within his own body is a terrifying engineering feat that Riku grudgingly commends.

title: The Underlying Anomaly
bio: Riku easily joined in on the collective banter and teasing surrounding George, but beneath the jokes, his analytical mind detected an unsettling anomaly he couldn't quite pinpoint, something subtly tying back to Fumio's parents. Despite his growing suspicion, Riku keeps his theories to himself for now, fully aware of how touchy and reactive George gets whenever the topic shifts anywhere near his personal life.

title: The Heavy Weight of Kin
bio: Makoto looks at Riku with a mix of envy and bitter resentment, watching him enjoy the normal childhood Makoto was denied through his parents' baggage. Understanding the heavy chip on his nephew's shoulder doesn't stop Riku from stepping up as the responsible relative, always standing firm to check Makoto and bring him down whenever his reckless outbursts threaten the group.

title: All in the Family
bio: Megumi finds a genuine sense of family warmth in  her Uncle Riku, a comforting bond she never got to experience in her own troubled household. For Riku, spending time with his niece offers something just as deeply meaningful, as he constantly sees the clear, living reflection of his elder sister Minna in her, fulfilling a quiet wish to stay connected to his sister's presence.

title: Model Behavior
bio: Riku is always on his absolute best behavior whenever Auntie Meari is around, making sure never to give her a single reason to lose her cool. He is convinced that tangoing with her bad side would be a special kind of hell he couldn't escape, so he wisely chooses absolute compliance over testing those waters.

title: Test of Time
bio: Riku is genuinely fascinated by how Uncle Hanzo managed to build such a strong bond with Auntie Meari despite his neurodivergent background and complex past. Whenever Riku brings it up, Hanzo simply chuckles and explains that it’s a long story—one where shared history, patience, and surviving life's trials together ultimately forged an unbreakable bond between them.

title: Playing it Safe
bio:
Riku is deeply relieved that Uncle Sato is one of the most relaxed, chill figures in their circle, keeping his expectations reasonable and easy to handle. 

Even so, Riku maintains a healthy level of caution around him, knowing that when the time comes, he will need Satoshi's formal approval regarding his relationship with Alicia. For now, Riku relies on steady consistency, determined to prove his worth and earn his full trust over time.

title: The Perfect Blueprint
bio: Michan has always been well aware of Riku's deep crush on Alicia, and she trusts his character enough to take him under her wing with tailored advice on how to be an exceptional partner. It is a seamless win-win: Riku gets invaluable guidance toward winning the heart of the girl he adores, while Michan gets to subtly shape the ideal companion for her daughter without ever overstepping her boundaries.

title: Echoes of Misstep
bio: Matsuda deeply respects Riku's sharp mind and his ambitious drive to join the ranks of the Irregular Hunters, though he maintains a vigilant, watchful eye on the young blood. Though Matsuda would never openly admit it, his caution is driven by a deep-seated fear of history repeating itself, unwilling to let Alicia suffer or get hurt at the hands of an incompetent partner.

title: When She Was Happier
bio:
Minna was a radiant presence in the family and an exceptional elder sister, making every moment Riku and his siblings spent with her unforgettable.

Hearing that she hit her absolute lowest point and chose complete isolation cut Riku to his core, shattering a piece of him in the process. His priorities are clear: once he ensures his sister is safe and whole again, he intends to track down and exact quiet, precise retribution on whoever drove her to that state.

title: Celebirty Crush
bio: Back when Riku was younger, he would constantly gushing about how, if he were only closer to Meili's age, he would have asked for her hand without a second thought. Even though a part of him still holds onto that same sentiment today, Meili graciously brushes off his persistent admiration, casually accepting the grand declarations as nothing more than an endearing compliment.

title: A Volatile Recommendation
bio: Akira genuinely believes the Irregular Hunters could benefit immensely from a sharp, creative mind like Riku's, constantly hyping up his potential to join the roster. The only hurdle is Riku's absolute refusal to move past Akira’s endless, shameless bragging about sleeping with his Auntie Meili—making every attempt at a serious pitch devolve into pure exasperation.

title: Soul Sisters
bio: Emma and Karin share an unbreakable, deep friendship where Emma constantly serves as Karin's ultimate savior, shielding her from the consequences of oversleeping and tidying up her disastrous room whenever she visits. Their affection and synergy are so seamless and intense that Vyse once genuinely assumed the two were in a romantic relationship.

title: Unspoken Grace
bio: Fumiko kept her past feelings for Vyse to herself for a long time, unwilling to cause unnecessary friction after being turned down due to his commitment to Emma. However, after getting to know Emma personally, Fumiko couldn't help but admire her, eventually confessing that Emma truly is the perfect partner for Vyse, a far cry from a certain someone who forces people and circumstances to bend to his own selfish agenda.

title: Rainbow-Colored Passions!
bio: As two of the original founding members of the school idol club, Emma and Setsuna share a powerful creative chemistry rooted in their absolute love for school idols. Their unwavering enthusiasm creates a perpetual feedback loop, continually pushing both of them to elevate their craft, refine their performances, and inspire one another to reach new heights.

title: Love the Life You Live
bio: Emma serves as a peaceful safe space for Shioriko, gently lifting the heavy burden of duty and high expectations she constantly carries on her shoulders. In Emma's warm, welcoming presence, the tension in Shioriko's naturally stiff, composed demeanor completely melts away, giving her a rare and precious opportunity to simply breathe and be herself.

title: Unlikely Lifesaver
bio: Controlled as a weapon by the Satsujin Clan during the Battle for Rulnei, Rikki was nearly executed by Matsuda once defeated. Emma intervened, standing between them to defend Rikki as a victim of manipulation rather than a true enemy, saving his life and offering him a chance at redemption. Rikki owes Emma his life after she

title: A Gentle Sanctuary
bio: George finds himself completely captivated by Emma's undeniable grace, drawn to the angelic aura and comforting charm that effortlessly puts his constant anxieties at ease. Despite finding solace in her presence, George respectfully declines any of her offers to pamper him, choosing to maintain a polite distance to honor her dignity, mindful of the fact that they aren't especially close.

title: Captive to the Gemstones
bio: Even Makoto's bitter hostility dissolved in the face of Emma's genuine generosity, completely unbothered even after he publicly humiliated and intimidated her. Struck by her unconditional forgiveness, Makoto became dangerously obsessed with her, endlessly fixated on her striking turquoise-gemstone eyes. Realizing brute force won't work on someone so disarmingly soft, he has resolved to shift tactics, calculating a far more insidious approach to pull her into his orbit and get exactly what he wants.

title: Shield Against the Shadow
bio: Emma was Megumi's very first friend, earning a place of permanent gratitude and deep affection in her heart. Recognizing the genuine warmth Emma brought into her life, Megumi has made it her personal mission to protect her, especially from the dangerous, obsessive tendencies of her own twin brother. Megumi routinely throws up roadblock after roadblock, making her blatant disapproval crystal clear whenever Makoto tries to maneuver his way close to Emma.

title: Employee of the Year
bio: During the early days of Meari's diner, Emma and the rest of the gang spent their free time helping out on the floor and keeping operations running. As a gesture of lifelong gratitude for helping lay the groundwork for Parhelion's eventual growth, Meari granted them permanent "Charter Member" status, entitling them to eat at her restaurant for free whenever they visit.

title: A Soft Harbor
bio: Matsuda always reminded Emma to show extra tenderness toward her Uncle Hanzo, knowing the immense hardship and pain he carried from the majority of his life. Taking the advice to heart without a second thought, Emma immediately showered Hanzo with warmth and gentle care, proving to him through every quiet gesture that she is yet another soul who values him deeply and refuses to let him feel alone.

title: Innocent Wonder
bio: Satoshi goes out of his way to ensure Emma has a wonderful time whenever their paths cross, bringing a bright, energetic warmth to every conversation. Emma genuinely adores his lively company, leaving her endlessly puzzled as to why her papa harbors such deep disdain and loathing toward a man who seems so remarkably sweet.

title: A Gentle Contrast
bio: Emma shares a remarkably sweet and easygoing bond with her Auntie Michan, feeling a natural, comforting warmth whenever they spend time together to the point its more obvious that they are related than the adoptive father. She remains endlessly fascinated by how remarkably different Michan's soft, lively personality is compared to the strict, immovable demeanor of her papa.

title: A Second Chance
bio: As a stern, prideful man hardened by life, raising Emma proved to be a transformative shift for Matsuda, offering him the rare privilege of fatherhood and a gentle presence to truly cherish. Haunted by the mistakes and overbearing control of his past with Michan, Matsuda is determined to do right by Emma, promising to place his absolute trust in her and grant her the freedom she deserves to grow on her own terms.

title: The Unofficial Co-Parent
bio: Rikka is profoundly grateful for Emma's presence, relying on her to keep Karin grounded and out of trouble whenever she isn't around. She practically views Emma as Karin's second mother at this point, though Rikka quietly hopes that taking on such a massive responsibility doesn't leave Emma completely burnt out from the stress.

title: Cherish Your Childhood
bio: Meili harbors a deep fondness for Emma's endearing naivety and boundless energy, quietly admiring her pure, child-like heart full of wonder and unyielding dreams. Wishing nothing but the absolute best for her future, Meili gently guides Emma whenever they meet, stoking her bright optimism while continually encouraging her to blossom into a strong, capable, and independent woman.

title: Is that what the Mask is for?
bio:
To Emma, Akira is an enigmatic figure from her father's circle whose face remains hidden behind a helmet. Beneath his impenetrable exterior, she senses a deep, quiet loneliness and often reaches out to bridge the gap.

However, Akira’s relentless operational schedule and commitment to total risk mitigation force him to maintain his distance.

title: Unconditional Hearth
bio: Aika pours her full heart into raising Emma, going out of her way to ensure she never feels like anything less than her trueborn child. Constantly surrounding her with warmth, reassurance, and unwavering support for all of her dreams, Aika serves as the solid emotional foundation that gives Emma the confidence to pursue her passions without fear.

title: A New Breath of Life
bio: Mira is deeply grateful for Emma's impact on their lives, recognizing how her presence brought genuine warmth and animation to Vyse during a time when he showed little to no emotion. Seeing the profound change in him, Mira warmly supports their bond, encouraging Emma to cherish Vyse, grow alongside him, and continuously inspire one another to become better versions of themselves.

title: Silent Shield
bio: Emma initially felt intimidated by Leng's naturally quiet demeanor and unintentionally cold presence, often unsure of how to approach him. However, her unease melted away upon realizing that Leng harbors deep gratitude for her, viewing her bond with Vyse as a transformative force in his life. Leng has since made his intentions clear, offering her a quiet sense of security by promising that she will always be safe under his protection.

title: Beauty in the Eye of the Beholder
bio: Karin and Fumiko love spending their quality time hanging out and enjoying classic, effortless "girly stuff" together. Karin fully believes that Fumiko harbors the natural beauty to be a high-end model herself, frequently hyping up her potential. Fumiko, on the other hand, stubbornly rejects the idea and convinced her own awkwardness and inability to strike a natural pose in ridiculous, high-fashion outfits completely disqualifies her from ever stepping onto a runway.

title: The Unsolved Mystery
bio: Karin was the single person sharp enough to deduce that Setsuna Yuki and Nana Nakagawa were actually the same person. Rather than blowing open Nijigasaki's "mystery of the decade" for the clout, Karin quietly chose to keep the secret locked away, valuing Setsuna's trust and their friendship far more than the thrill of exposing the truth.

title: Sparks of Ambition
bio: Karin opened up to a curious Shioriko about her roots, revealing how she was once just an ordinary countryside girl before stumbling upon fashion magazines that ignited her dream to become a model. Hearing Karin's journey struck a deep chord with Shioriko, inspiring her to take control of her own destiny and make bold life choices driven by what she genuinely loves rather than rigid expectations.

title: Calm After the Storm
bio: Rikki felt deep remorse for the unsaid trouble he had caused during his time under enemy control, eventually offering Karin a sincere and long-overdue apology. Understanding that he was merely an unwilling pawn in a cruel game, Karin offered her full forgiveness without hesitation. Now, with the past put to rest, she takes on the role of another big sister in his life, guiding a version of Rikki that feels much calmer and more in control of himself.

title: I got nothing
bio: Nothing particularly notable ever occurs between Karin and George. They simply maintain a quiet, mutual distance, opting to politely ignore each other whenever their paths happen to cross.

title: Transactional Fallout
bio: Karin and Makoto were once in a strictly strategic, calculated relationship, a purely transactional arrangement used to extract high-value intelligence from each other until it served no further purpose. Since dropping the facade, Karin harbors an intense, burning hatred for Makoto, utterly repulsed by his smug, snarky attitude and infuriated by how effortlessly he gets away with being a manipulative, rude bastard who constantly hurts her friends.

title: Unexpected Night Owls
bio: Karin frequently takes on a protective, teasing elder-sister role with Megumi, keeping a watchful eye over her during their group outings. Whenever the girls gather for a night out, the two surprisingly end up talking far more than anyone would expect, forging an unexpectedly deep, comfortable connection that catches the rest of the group off guard.

title: The Black Sheep
bio:
While Karin unmistakably inherited Rikka’s stunning looks and polished physical elegance, the similarity largely stops there. Her preference for quiet solitude and her complete disinterest in joining the Student Council mirror her father instead.

Either way, Rikka is proud her daughter is self-sufficient at an early age.

title: Role Reversal
bio: NOT REGISTERED YET

title: The Prez and The Secretary
bio: Setsuna places absolute, unshakeable trust in Fumiko, viewing her as one of the most reliable and adaptable assets in the field. On duty, they execute missions with seamless, uncompromising professionalism and mutual precision. Once the assignments end and the armor comes off, their dynamic relaxes into a comfortable camaraderie where they share quiet downtime and step out of their demanding roles to unwind.

title: Perspective Duality
bio:
They share a genuine friendship rooted in mutual respect, even as they acknowledge the clear flaws in each other's lifestyle. While Fumiko admires Shioriko's discipline, she worries that Shioriko rarely allows herself to simply have fun. Conversely, Shioriko respects Fumiko's remarkable efficiency on duty, yet remains critical of her tendency to chase unnecessary distractions. 

Despite these contrasting mindsets, their time together is built on a deep understanding of each other's core values, using their differences to keep one another grounded.

title: Paralyphobia
bio: Fumiko maintains a constant, uneasy vigil over Rikki due to his abnormal physical traits and condition. Even after his friends and family confirmed he is in perfect health, the confirmation did nothing to ease her deep-seated suspicion. While she is fully accustomed to extraordinary magical abilities in others, Rikki's sheer instability makes him feel like an unpredictable variable that defies safe operational logic, keeping her on high alert whenever he is near.

title: A Setsuna Oshi?
bio: Fumiko has long been George’s primary point of contact whenever he needs to track down Setsuna, a routine that quickly led her to piece together his true feelings. Every time he asks, the obvious flush on his face betrays his intentions, prompting a smug, knowing smirk from Fumiko that instantly flusters him and throws him off balance. Though she enjoys teasing him, she quietly keeps his secret while playing along with his attempts to stay composed.

title: Offloader from Hell
bio: As co-secretaries on the Student Council, Fumiko and Makoto sit on opposite ends of the operational spectrum. Makoto takes immense delight in discreetly slipping his unfinished duties onto Fumiko’s desk, treating her growing irritation as prime entertainment. While Makoto's slacking has fostered genuine resentment in Fumiko, her strict personal standard forces her to swallow her anger and maintain a crisp, uncompromising level of professionalism—even as she looks for ways to settle the score without breaking protocol.

title: A Stark Contrast
bio: Whenever Makoto brings Megumi along to the Student Council room, Megumi takes the opportunity to check in on Fumiko, asking if her brother has been causing her any trouble. Faced with the reality of Makoto's persistent slacking and prankster habits, Fumiko confirms that he is indeed a handful, prompting Megumi to offer sincere apologies on his behalf. The stark difference between Megumi's considerate demeanor and Makoto's infuriating antics leaves Fumiko genuinely bewildered as to how two such drastically different people could come from the same family.

title: Echoes of My Youth
bio: Meari takes immense pride in her son Fumio’s choice, fully expecting nothing less than a complete total package like Fumiko to catch his eye. Observing the quiet dynamic and devotion between Fumio and Fumiko brings back fond memories of Meari's own teenage romance. Seeing the young couple together fills her with a warm, nostalgic satisfaction, and she warmly embraces Fumiko as an irreplaceable part of her son's life.

title: The Fum-Fum Paradox
bio: Hanzo takes frequent delight in the playful similarity of their names, using it as a recurring running joke between them. Fumiko naturally gravitated toward Hanzo, finding his character, experiences, and magnetic personality genuinely fascinating. Unfiltered in her praise, she often compliments his innate charisma, while Hanzo appreciates her close presence and sharp mind.

title: A Small World
bio: Satoshi first took note of Fumiko while attending Alicia's student-athlete events, recognizing her presence in the school administration. His surprise came later when he connected the dots and realized that the extremely capable Student Council secretary was actually in a relationship with his nephew, Fumio.

title: Chase or Concentrate?
bio:
Raised under the same roof as foster sisters, Setsuna and Shioriko share an unstoppable drive—once either sets her mind to a goal, total execution is practically guaranteed. Despite their deep sisterly bond, their fundamental philosophies once fiercely collided.

Setsuna fought for reckless passion and grand dreams, while Shioriko stood firm on cold efficiency, pragmatic choices, and guaranteed outcomes.

title: Opposing Vocal Talents
bio: Disregarding Rikki’s sharp, unapproachable aura, Setsuna never hesitated to pull him directly into the group and make him feel included. Her persistent efforts paid off unexpectedly when she discovered he was reading a light novel series she was deeply passionate about. While Setsuna excitedly dove into high-energy discussions about plots and theories, Rikki found himself pushed to his absolute limit of fatigue, using every ounce of energy just to survive the relentless barrage of conversation.

title: Always Meet Your Idols
bio: How their dynamic began remains a closely guarded secret that George stubbornly refuses to share, though rumors suggest he was simply a dedicated fan who happened to run into the star herself at the right moment. Today, Setsuna freely drags him along to assist with production, relying on his support to pull off her absolute best live performances. While George remains content helping behind the scenes, standing so close to the spotlit icon has undoubtedly put a massive target on his back from an army of jealous fans.

title: Deny Him from Cancel Culture
bio: Setsuna is fully aware of the constant stream of complaints regarding Makoto’s behavior and has been repeatedly urged to kick him off the Student Council. However, she refuses, recognizing the harsh reality that no one else is willing to handle his workload, making his removal a massive logistical disaster. She compromises by constantly pleading with him to maintain basic professionalism and avoid pissing off the staff—a minimal standard Makoto is currently failing at spectacular levels.

title: The Otaku Mine
bio:
Setsuna initially maintained a strictly professional demeanor around Megumi, keeping her true interests under wraps. However, the second Megumi dropped a subtle hint revealing her own deep knowledge of anime and manga, Setsuna's formal exterior completely dissolved. 

Unveiling her fiercely passionate otaku side, Setsuna quickly formed an intense, enthusiastic bond with Megumi, creating a space where both could fully relate over their shared obsessions.

title: Fanged Flame
bio:
In a rare feat, Rikki managed the seemingly impossible by genuinely intimidating Shioriko during their very first encounter.

Assigned to assist him due to his status as a student with a disability, Shioriko quickly became the center of Rikki’s attention; he took an immediate liking to her and voiced his feelings with unreserved, unapologetic transparency. Though initially caught off guard by his shameless declarations, Shioriko gradually fell for him in return, finding in Rikki a rare sanctuary—someone who could effortlessly quiet the constant weight of her worries and bring clarity to her mind.

title: Sister's Stagehand
bio: Shioriko’s interactions with George occur solely because of Setsuna, as coordinate efforts and stage management repeatedly bring them into the same space. This frequent contact remains a bizarre novelty for Shioriko, who finds it deeply unusual to have a male presence so consistently in her sister's circle, given her complete lack of close male friends.

title: Student Council's Finest
bio: Makoto refuses to cross paths or pick fights with Shioriko, driven entirely by a sense of practical pity. Recognizing that picking a battle against someone as ruthlessly logical and highly rational as her is a completely fruitless endeavor, he chooses the path of least resistance. Rather than waste energy on a debate he can't win, Makoto decides it's infinitely smarter to stay on her good side—or at the very least, stand on the same team.

title: Path to Success
bio: Shioriko constantly urges Megumi to capitalize on her unique skills and leverage her talents to their absolute fullest. Recognizing her own limitations when it comes to guiding Megumi through complex social dynamics, Shioriko pivots to what she does best: strategic advancement. If she can't directly fix Megumi's interpersonal struggles, she resolves to channel that potential into concrete achievement, ensuring Megumi secures a successful and self-reliant future.

title: A Different Fumio
bio:
Meari was initially stunned to discover her saint-like husband had an artificial child, but her relief was immediate upon learning it was no affair. 

Hearing Rikki refer to her as a mother melted away any remaining hesitation; driven by pure motherly instinct and a deep sympathy for the painful trials of his existence, she fully stepped into the role of his mother figure, bestowing upon Rikki the genuine love, warmth, and care of a true parent.

title: Reclaim His Youth
bio: Hanzo was initially at a total loss for words when an artificial child suddenly identified him and his comrade as his parents, finding it to be an extremely awkward adjustment. Once he understood the full, tragic context behind the boy's creation and past, Hanzo fully embraced the role of his father, stepping up to ensure Rikki would never be denied the genuine childhood that had been stolen from him for so long.

During Rikki's time under the Satsujin clan, Matsuda personally put three bullets into him—one in the back and two in the knees. With Rikki now newly rehabilitated and freely walking around, Matsuda's occasional glances toward him are loaded with intense, heavy awkwardness, especially whenever a nonchalant Rikki casually and innocently waves at the man who tried to put him 6 feet under.

title: All Hail The New Prince
bio:
Learning that she shared a direct blood connection with Rikki awakened a deep, undeniable instinct inside Meili, driving her to shower him with care and attention. 

Already well-versed in watching over a fostered little sister, stepping into the role of a mother for her biological son felt like a cakewalk.

title: Child Support, Accomplished
bio:
They were officially introduced after Meili and Akira declared their relationship. 

Without hesitation, Akira immediately stepped up to prove himself as a reliable father figure for Rikki, dedicating himself to providing for the young man and fully supporting his growth as he navigates his new life.

title: Forgive But Couldn't Forget
bio: Feeling responsible for her husband’s past actions and the bullets he put into him, Aika personally takes it upon herself to compensate by welcoming Rikki into her presence with open arms. She deeply respects Rikki’s fierce determination to turn his life around, commending his resolve to atone for his past wrongdoings and offering him the grace and support he deserves.

title: Jealous Onii-chan
bio: Having relied solely on each other for most of their lives, Makoto harbors a deeply rooted, overprotective instinct toward Megumi, wanting nothing more than to shield her from harm. However, as Megumi found her stride within a new social group, she began carving out her own independence and asserting her autonomy. Makoto frequently warns her that her new friends will eventually let her down, but Megumi counters without hesitation, teasingly firing back that he is simply envious of her close place alongside Emma and the rest of the circle.

title: The Day the Devil Shivers
bio:
To Matsuda, Makoto represents the exact type of reckless, unstable element he swore to keep far away from his family—and of all the potential targets in the world, Makoto had to set his sights on his daughter. 

While Makoto stubbornly tries to charm his way into his self-proclaimed "father-in-law's" good graces, Matsuda's patience wears paper-thin. Every time Makoto opens his mouth to bridge the gap, Matsuda finds himself a split second away from pulling the trigger right between his eyes.

title: No Milk in Sight
bio: Makoto harbors deep-seated hatred and bitterness toward his mother, viewing her as weak-willed for abandoning her responsibility when he and Megumi needed her most. Forcing himself to step into the guardian role at a young age, he holds Minna entirely accountable for their hard upbringing, unable to forgive her absence or respect her choice to leave them to navigate the world alone.

title: Your Daughter Will Be Mine
bio: Aika harbors absolute zero tolerance when it comes to Makoto. Shaken by the realization that the grim world of objectification she once faced is following her own daughter, she actively warns and rallies the rest of the group to shield Emma from creeps like him at all costs. For Aika, it's an uncompromising maternal duty to protect Emma from the subtle dangers she knows all too well.

title: The Resonance Exists
bio: Megumi quietly understands why Minna felt forced to retreat and hide away from the world, having inherited that same fragile self-esteem. However, that understanding brings little comfort; Megumi harbors a deep, secret wish that they could have hidden together, rather than Minna fleeing and leaving her behind to endure the hardships brought on by her father.

title: One in a Million
bio: Hanzo was the only man who ever unlocked Meari's capacity for genuine, unconditional love, just as Meari was the first person to ever give Hanzo a true sense of warmth and affection in his life. Bound by a deep, unwavering devotion to one another, they are absolute perfection together. A rare, once-in-a-lifetime pairing.

title: Spot the Sato
bio: Meari was one of the few people who could effortlessly tell the twins apart back when they looked virtually identical. As she spent more time getting to know him, their dynamic naturally evolved into a genuine, protective brotherly connection.

title: Destined Sisters
bio: As two childhood friends, they always planned to have their children to be born at the same time. Thanks to them, their families grew together with the twins getting to spend the time they've lost, and Fumio and Alicia developed a sibling-bond.

title: Silent Vows
bio: Though they grew up together, their bond deteriorated into mutual resentment. After Matsuda confessed his feelings to Meari, she rejected him due to his chaotic and contradictory mindset—oscillating wildly between liking her and hating her. Nowadays, they maintain a cold, polite distance and ignore each other, yet beneath the bitterness remains a deep-seated foundation of trust: if either ever fell into real danger, both would step up to defend the other without a second thought.

title: Timeless Assurance
bio: Meari is constantly amused, and slightly incredulous, that Kaito hasn't changed one bit since they were kids. However, as a wise and perceptive individual, she recognizes his steadfast nature and trusts him implicitly with the things most dear to her.

title: Unraveling Bond
bio: Bound together since their troubled teenage years, Meari and Minna were inseparable anchor points who always had each other's backs. When Minna spiraled and withdrew from the world, Meari's anxiety grew exponentially with each passing day, deeply heartbroken and stunned to realize that out of everyone Minna shut out, Meari herself was not spared from the isolation.

title: A Safe Harbor
bio: Rikka has consistently served as a vital grounding presence for Meari during her darkest mental struggles and lowest moments. Acting as an informal therapist of sorts, Rikka provides the patient guidance, listening ear, and stability Meari needs to navigate her mind when things get overwhelming.

title: Women Empowerment!
bio: Meili has always found Meari's work ethic deeply admirable, possessing a keen understanding of the driving forces behind Meari's aspirations. Recognizing the exact roots of what Meari wants and needs to fulfill her dream, Meili offers thoughtful support grounded in shared ambition and mutual respect.

title: Beyond the Feud
bio: Despite the mutual hatred between Meari and Matsuda, Meari and Aika get along wonderfully, bonding deeply over their shared experiences as mothers. They serve as each other's trusted go-to for babysitting, even if Matsuda can barely tolerate being around the Hasashi kids for a single second.

title: Fillet & Fine Cuts
bio: Mira serves as Meari's primary sponsor for sourcing quality seafood goods, going above and beyond simple supply by passing down her hands-on expertise. Under Mira's guidance, Meari learned how to effortlessly extract meat from lobsters, carve salmon, and fillet halibut like soft butter.

title: Name Your Price
bio: Meari holds immense respect for Leng's lethal assassin skill set, trusting his abilities enough to hire him legally whenever her children require absolute protection from imminent threat. In return, when Leng sought an extra side gig at her restaurant, Meari gladly brought him on board, granting him a position as her trusted bartender.

title: Synchronized Horizons
bio: Following their initial reunion, Hanzo’s personal struggles and discomfort initially kept them from spending meaningful time together. It was only after Hanzo received the help he needed that the two were finally able to bridge the gap between them, sharing the quality time required to build a genuine, unbreakable twin bond across their distinct differences.

title: Something Ain't Right...
bio: Michan frequently fell victim to confusing the twins, accidentally mistaking Hanzo for her lover during their identical-looking phase. To spare everyone from the awkward unprompted hugs and Meari chewing his wife out, Satoshi was ultimately forced to change his hairstyle just to establish a clear visual difference.

title: The Better Twin
bio: Matsuda stood out as one of Hanzo's greatest advocates, actively pushing him to overcome his deep-seated inferiority complex and opening his eyes to the reality that Meari loved him back. Despite Hanzo's repeated efforts to reward or repay him for his guidance, Matsuda consistently refused every gesture, asking for nothing in return except that Hanzo learn to finally believe in himself.

title: The Two Sofites
bio: Bound by a shared, grounded demeanor, they often find themselves in long conversations where their serene natures naturally align. Their bond deepened through working together, leading Meari to frequently observe that despite any outward differences, the two men are far more alike than either of them realizes.

title: Meari's Favorite People
bio: Minna's genuine warmth and kindness were among the very few forces capable of piercing Hanzo's guarded exterior during their youth, making her one of the rare people he naturally allowed himself to open up to. Over the years, their bond has matured into a sweet, effortless friendship, one so naturally close that it occasionally sparks a flash of jealousy in Meari.

title: Chase Them Away
bio: Rikka takes immense pride in seeing the man Hanzo has grown into, fondly remembering the days when she had to step in as a Student Council President and chase away bullies on his behalf. At the same to her utter surprise, she remains continuously shocked by his evolution into a sarcastic, playful wit, a sharp-tongued transformation she suspects he picked up directly from his wife.

title: Bittersweet Gratitude
bio: Their connection began on opposite sides of a blade, but everything shifted the moment Hanzo saved Meili's life from a fatal fall. That rescue sparked a deep affection in Meili that eventually bloomed into unrequited love; however, upon realizing she was not the person destined to give Hanzo the true comfort he needed, she selflessly let her feelings go, stepping aside so he could be with the one person who truly held his heart.

title: The Princess' True Love
bio: The two were officially introduced when Meili announced her new relationship with Akira. Hanzo warmly congratulated Akira on finding a place alongside one of the most energetic women he had ever known, assuring him with total sincerity that they formed an exceptional match destined for true happiness.

title: Been There, Enough of That
bio: Aika constantly gushes over how sweet, charming, and self-assured Hanzo appears, finding it almost impossible to picture a time when he lacked confidence. Yet, having survived her own abusive past, she shares a quiet, profound empathy with him, recognizing the invisible scars and hard-won strength required to rebuild oneself from trauma.

title: Wallflowers in Full Bloom
bio: Back in their school days, Hanzo and Mira knew each other primarily as the remarkably quiet, shy partners attached to the far more outgoing Meari and Leng. Years later, those former days of standing in the shadows have transformed into a shared inside joke, giving them both a warm reason to laugh and appreciate just how far they have grown into their own skin.

title: An Eye for Your Trust
bio: Sent as a child on a dark mandate to assassinate Hanzo, Leng was instead repelled when Hanzo, newly trained in the arts of the Author Gods, defended himself and reluctantly slashed Leng’s eye out. Cast aside by his own family as a failure following the defeat, Leng chose to abandon his past and pledge his loyalty to the Author Gods, whose mercy granted him a second chance at redemption.

title: Everlasting Shine
bio: Satoshi stands as Michan's first and only true love, offering her the genuine warmth, affection, and bubbly joy of being cherished for who she truly is. By providing absolute acceptance that washed away the heavy weight of her past sins, Satoshi built a bond with her defined by unmatched chemistry, leaving them both devoted to walking hand-in-hand well into their old age.

title: Love Me, Onii-chan!
bio: Matsuda absolutely hates Satoshi's guts, but he cannot deny the genuine happiness and respect Satoshi brings into Michan's life while honoring her boundaries. Beneath their intense personal rivalry lies a foundation of profound mutual respect, binding them together in a deep, unspoken partnership as absolute equals.

title: Whirlwind in the Quiet Hours
bio: Kaito finds Satoshi's boundless energy utterly overwhelming, frequently getting dragged into spontaneous excursions that leave him with precious little time to focus on his actual work. Yet beneath the constant exhaustion, Kaito harbors a quiet appreciation for the dynamic, finding a strange comfort in being so actively sought out by one of the "cool guys."

title: Bookworms Want to Have Fun Too!
bio: Minna takes immense pride in calling someone as strong, hilariously funny, tough, and genuinely friendly as Satoshi her friend. She naturally gravitates toward his larger-than-life presence, finding a sense of joyful security and unbridled fun whenever they hang out.

title: Scars and Smiles
bio: They share a sharp, effortless banter that turns both their greatest triumphs and absolute worst days into material for mutual laughter. Their relationship thrives on an unvarnished honesty, using lighthearted ribbing as a comfortable space to reflect on how much they have survived and grown.

title: The Uninvited Liability
bio: Satoshi remains thoroughly indignant over being excluded from Matsuda and Aika's ultra-exclusive two-guest wedding, where Michan was the sole representative from their household. Aika can only laugh at his dramatic outrage, cheerfully reminding him that Matsuda simply refused to risk having the single most important day of his life derailed by Satoshi's predictable shenanigans.

title: Double the Trouble
bio: When it comes to babysitting duty, Leng outright refuses to trust Satoshi anywhere near his child. Knowing Satoshi is already hyperactive as hell on a normal day, Leng shudders at the pure chaos that unfolds when he is paired with Alicia, whose reckless streak easily outmatches Satoshi's by tenfold.

title: Forever My Hero!
bio: Bound by a shared trial, the two siblings survived their own temporary hell by clinging to each other as their sole reason to keep living. Though Matsuda’s protective instincts can border on overbearing, Michan somehow always manages to get away with things she definitely shouldn't, they're held together by an unbreakable sibling bond that endures through every hardship.

title: The Safest Target
bio: Kaito is one of the few people Michan feels completely comfortable teasing and bantering with on a regular basis. She genuinely appreciates that he's sweet enough not to harbor real malice toward her despite her constant teasing, and she considers his exasperated reactions to be some of the absolute funniest moments of her daily life.

title: Dawn of an Unbreakable Bond
bio: Michan initially harbored a quiet resentment toward Minna, convinced she had been brought in to replace her as Meari's new best friend. That insecurity melted away as the two spent more time together, revealing a far deeper, natural compatibility between them, evolving into two first-years running side-by-side, leaving past doubts behind to live life entirely to the fullest by eating the biggest meals.

title: B̶a̶d̶ ̶B̶o̶y̶s̶ Good Guys
bio:
Though their contrasting temperaments might suggest otherwise, Matsuda and Kaito boast one of the most powerful dynamics in the entire roster. 

Having grown up together as close friends before stepping into the fray as eventual co-workers, their bond is built on years of absolute trust. Kaito's brilliant, high-level tactical strategies paired with Matsuda's flawless, lethal execution make them an extraordinary and formidable duo on the field.

title: Keep Your Head Up, Kid
bio: Their bond began under chaotic circumstances when Matsuda accidentally kidnapped Minna for a dirty assignment, only to immediately turn around and free her himself upon realizing the mistake. As they spent time together in the aftermath, a genuine trust blossomed between them; Matsuda went on to become a vital pillar of support in Minna's life, offering the consistent encouragement she needed to step out of her shell and build true self-confidence.

title: Uncanny Substitute
bio:
As core members of their new group, Matsuda and Meili unintentionally step into the precise roles left vacant by each other's former comrades.

For Meili, Matsuda serves as the familiar sarcastic, unshakeable presence she used to rely on. For Matsuda, Meili perfectly fills the spot of the delightfully annoying woman who takes endless pleasure in shattering his ego whenever she pleases.

title: Parallel Minds
bio: They are remarkably close comrades and operating partners who think so much alike they practically share a single mindset on the job. Yet despite this profound mental synergy and shared history, life pulled them toward wildly different destinations—paths neither of them ever intended, envisioned, or expected to walk.

title: Solace in the Shared Space
bio: Constantly brought together by a shared work environment they could never truly separate from, the two gradually found an effortless comfort in one another's presence. In a poetic twist of fate, two individuals widely written off as entirely unable to find a romantic partner ended up finding theirs in each other.

title: Grudging Future-In-Laws
bio: Matsuda made no secret of his initial strong disapproval of Leng’s son as a match for his daughter. A silent war of protective glares that Leng remained entirely, obliviously indifferent to. Eventually, Leng was just relieved when Matsuda finally came around to accepting that the boy was actually perfect for Emma, if only because the relentless death stares were starting to get genuinely annoying.

title: Beneath the Scowl
bio: Minna was initially scared of Leng, completely intimidated by his cold, menacing demeanor. Her entire perspective shifted the moment she noticed him lingering behind just to eat her "Goodbye Biscuits," realizing that beneath his perpetually grumpy exterior lay another absolute softie at heart.

title: Not for the Kitchen
bio: Meili is completely obsessed with Rikka’s strong sense of independence and deep, genuine compassion. Viewing her as someone to truly look up to, Meili actively uses Rikka’s example as proof that she herself still has a thing or two to learn when it comes to standing tall and caring for others.

title: Shipping Waiting to Happen?
bio: Sharing an identical demeanor, quiet stoicism, and practical mindset, the two project a startlingly harmonious aura that leaves those around them suspecting they could have easily ended up together in another life.

title: Under the Royal Sheets
bio: Assigned to safeguard the princess, Akira's partnership with Meili began in friction, marked by constant bickering and heated disagreements before they finally saw through each other's guards to realize how deeply they cared. After sharing nights of raw passion, the armor they had worn for years finally shattered, forcing them both to embrace the overwhelming, tender feelings they had spent so long trying to deny.

title: New Horizons
bio: Matching each other's energy with effortless ease, they quickly cemented a deep, lasting friendship. For Meili, who had felt lost after her original friend group went their separate ways, finding Aika opened the door to a vibrant new circle where she could finally belong and feel at home again.

title: The Glory Days
bio: Bound by their shared journeys as authors, Meili and Leng have navigated countlessly wild, creative adventures together. Meili thrives in this collaborative dynamic, having the absolute time of her life as part of their tight-knit storytelling circle.

title: Last Minute Elopement
bio:
Mira harbored genuine feelings for Leng throughout their teenage years, though she never found the right moment to confess. 

Decades later, watching everyone in his circle settle down, Leng decided it was time to get married himself, and seeing Mira still single, he settled with her.
